scope: Small synthetic exact-oracle experiment; no field, scale, multimodal, or statistical generalization claim

input.distance: Euclidean in arbitrary distance units; speed=1; no rounding during optimization
input.time_window_semantics: Inclusive bounds on START OF SERVICE; wait allowed; travel/service nonnegative; all routes return to depot
input.geometry_strata: G01-G08 uniform square [-10,10]^2; G09-G16 alternating two Gaussian clusters at (-6,-6)/(6,6), sigma1.8 clipped to [-10,10]; coordinates rounded to3 decimals
input.window_generation: Compute earliest start times on fixed label-order capacity-feasible reference routes without windows; add seeded uniform[-8,8] jitter; windows [max(0,center-halfwidth),max(0,center+halfwidth)]
input.bias: All windows are centered near a fixed label-order witness. Medium/wide contain that witness. Tight may be infeasible. This favors reference-compatible chronology; no screening, rejection, tuning, or resampling. 16 related triples, not48 independent draws.

algorithms.distance_first: Repeatedly choose globally minimum additional distance among all capacity/time-window/depot-return feasible insertions. Ties node,vehicle,position. Stop when no insertion feasible.
algorithms.time_window_first: Same candidates, key earliest node deadline, then largest minimum slack on candidate modified route, then added distance,node,vehicle,position.
algorithms.shared_improvement: After construction, at most5 rounds best improving feasible single-node relocations (including cross-route) and within-route segment reversals; retry greedy insertion once; another at most5 improvement rounds. Preserve served nodes. Improvement objective total distance; deterministic lexicographic route ties.
algorithms.diagnostic: Exact capacity-only minimum-distance full-service solution, tie lexicographic ordered routes, replayed unchanged under time windows; not a third heuristic.

exact_oracle: Enumerate all ordered subsets with load<=6, retain feasible minimum-distance route for each mask. Combine disjoint masks for2 vehicles. Full optimum null if infeasible; additionally exact max-coverage/min-distance and exact optimum on each heuristic's precise served mask. Empty routes allowed. Exhaustive, no heuristic pruning.

primary: Full-service success over oracle-feasible cases with denominator
Served tasks out of336 and exact maximum coverage
paired full-service outcomes by16 geometry triples
secondary: Late starts, overload, late depot returns, missing and duplicate nodes
Full optimum gap only feasible-full cases, denominator reported
Same-served-mask feasible optimum gap, excluding empty masks
Coverage shortfall vs exact max coverage
CPU by generation/tests/oracles/heuristics/checking/analysis, with complete workload CPU
analysis.no_imputation: Infeasible full objective is JSON null, never0. All instances and failures retained. Feasible subset gaps cannot substitute for full-service rate.
analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive paired counts only. No p-values or population claims; nested widths are not independent.
analysis.prespecified_conclusions: Report whichever heuristic wins/ties/loses. Reject universal superiority. Distinguish constraint-gated distance-first failure from capacity-only distance optimum violating windows.

checker: Independent implementation re-derives Euclidean distances, route loads, arrival/wait/start/departure, inclusive windows, depot returns, missing/duplicate/unknown nodes from original nodes and routes; never uses solver distance matrix or feasibility function. Adversarial unit tests plus brute full-permutation split cross-check on G01 andG09 each width.
budget: Standard library only. One child workload process hard RLIMIT_CPU110s and supervisor hard RLIMIT_CPU9s, aggregate OS hard bound119s<=120s. No network,API,paid service,installation,orCodex. Entire child CPU measured with wait4, including generation,freeze,tests,solve,analysis,exports; parent packaging separately measured. All unfinished/failed cases retained if interrupted.
freeze: All inputs, protocol, experiment implementation, checker, supervisor and planned analysis SHA256 hashed before any route optimization. No solver pilot or tuning run. On implementation failure, retain logs/freeze and state any amended rerun explicitly.
